title: Maximum Subarray (Memoization)
statement:
Given an integer array `nums`, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.
Solve this using a DP/memoization approach: let `dp[i]` = maximum subarray sum ending at index `i`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# dp[i] = max sum ending at i = max(nums[i], dp[i-1] + nums[i])
